name: CES 2027
shortDescription: The global stage for consumer technology, from AI and robotics to mobility and digital health.
fullDescription: CES is one of the world's largest consumer technology exhibitions, bringing together established manufacturers, startups and investors to showcase products that will shape the year ahead. Visitors can explore dedicated zones for artificial intelligence, robotics, connected mobility, smart home, gaming and digital health, attend keynotes from industry leaders, and meet suppliers looking for distribution and retail partnerships. For exhibitors, CES offers an unmatched opportunity to launch new products in front of international buyers and media.
altText: Visitors walking through a large technology exhibition hall at CES 2027

name: Gulfood 2027
shortDescription: A major global food and beverage sourcing event connecting suppliers with buyers across the Middle East, Africa and Asia.
fullDescription: Gulfood is a leading international food and beverage trade show hosted in Dubai, a strategic gateway between producers and fast-growing consumer markets in the Middle East, Africa and South Asia. Exhibitors present everything from dairy, meat and beverages to confectionery, plant-based products and halal-certified ranges. Buyers can taste new products, negotiate supply contracts and discover emerging trends in sustainable and functional foods, while conference sessions cover food security, retail innovation and cross-border trade.
altText: Food and beverage exhibitors displaying products at the Gulfood 2027 trade show in Dubai

name: WHX Dubai 2027
shortDescription: The Middle East's flagship healthcare exhibition for medical devices, diagnostics and hospital technology.
fullDescription: WHX Dubai brings the global healthcare community together under one roof, spanning medical equipment, diagnostics, digital health, orthopaedics, laboratory solutions and hospital infrastructure. Procurement teams, clinicians and distributors meet manufacturers from around the world to evaluate new technologies and build regional partnerships. A parallel conference programme explores topics such as telemedicine, AI-assisted diagnostics, healthcare workforce development and sustainable hospital design.
altText: Healthcare professionals visiting medical equipment stands at WHX Dubai 2027

name: PACK EXPO East 2027
shortDescription: East Coast packaging and processing show covering machinery, materials, automation and sustainable solutions.
fullDescription: PACK EXPO East gathers packaging and processing professionals from food, beverage, pharmaceutical, personal care and consumer goods companies. Attendees can see packaging machinery in action, compare materials and containers, and learn about automation, track-and-trace and sustainable packaging innovations. Education sessions and live demonstrations help operations and procurement teams find practical ways to reduce waste, improve line efficiency and meet changing regulatory expectations.
altText: Packaging machinery on display on the exhibition floor at PACK EXPO East 2027

name: Hospitalar 2027
shortDescription: Latin America's largest healthcare fair, featuring hospital equipment, medical technology and clinical services.
fullDescription: Hospitalar is a leading healthcare exhibition and congress in Latin America, connecting hospitals, clinics, laboratories and distributors with suppliers of medical devices, hospital furniture, diagnostics, IT systems and clinical services. International pavilions give foreign manufacturers a direct route into the Brazilian market, while the congress programme addresses healthcare management, digital transformation and patient safety. It is an ideal event for companies seeking regional distribution partners.
altText: Delegates attending the Hospitalar 2027 healthcare exhibition in São Paulo

name: COMPUTEX 2027
shortDescription: Asia's premier computing and electronics show, spanning AI hardware, semiconductors and next-generation devices.
fullDescription: COMPUTEX is one of the most important annual gatherings for the global computing supply chain. Chipmakers, hardware brands, system integrators and start-ups present AI servers, PC components, networking equipment, embedded systems and emerging technologies. Buyers from around the world use the show to scout suppliers, secure manufacturing partners and preview products before their market launch, while forums and keynotes examine the future of AI infrastructure and edge computing.
altText: Computer hardware and electronics booths at COMPUTEX 2027 in Taipei

name: ProPak Asia 2027
shortDescription: Southeast Asia's leading processing and packaging technology exhibition for food, beverage and pharma manufacturers.
fullDescription: ProPak Asia is a major trade event for processing and packaging technology in Southeast Asia. It serves manufacturers of food, beverages, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics and household products, offering a wide range of filling, labelling, converting and robotics solutions. Regional and international suppliers meet buyers looking to modernise production lines, and the show floor highlights smart factory technologies, sustainable materials and flexible packaging formats.
altText: Automated packaging line demonstration at ProPak Asia 2027 in Bangkok

name: Summer Fancy Food Show 2027
shortDescription: North America's showcase for specialty foods, artisan beverages and gourmet products.
fullDescription: The Summer Fancy Food Show is a trade-only event dedicated to specialty and gourmet food and beverage. Independent producers and international brands present cheeses, charcuterie, snacks, sauces, confectionery, coffee, tea and non-alcoholic drinks to specialty retailers, restaurateurs and distributors. The show highlights emerging flavour trends and offers buyers a chance to discover small-batch and heritage products that are hard to find through traditional sourcing channels.
altText: Specialty food products arranged on display at the Summer Fancy Food Show 2027

name: FACHPACK 2027
shortDescription: Europe's packaging trade fair covering materials, machinery, labelling and logistics solutions.
fullDescription: FACHPACK is a leading European exhibition for packaging, processing and logistics. Suppliers present packaging materials, containers, labelling and coding systems, filling and sealing machinery, and sustainable alternatives to single-use plastics. Visitors from food, pharmaceutical, cosmetics and industrial sectors come to compare solutions, meet technical specialists and attend forums on recyclability, regulation and circular-economy design.
altText: Visitors comparing packaging materials and machinery at FACHPACK 2027 in Nuremberg

name: Anuga 2027
shortDescription: One of the world's largest food and beverage trade fairs, organised into specialised product halls.
fullDescription: Anuga is a global food and beverage trade fair held in Cologne, organised into themed sections such as dairy, meat, frozen food, bread and bakery, fine food, drinks and hotel and catering supplies. Producers from across the world present new products to international retailers, wholesalers and foodservice buyers. Beyond sourcing, the event features trend areas, start-up showcases and expert talks on alternative proteins, sustainability and the future of food retail.
altText: Buyers sampling products at themed food halls during Anuga 2027 in Cologne

name: GITEX Global 2027
shortDescription: A large international technology and start-up event covering AI, cybersecurity, cloud and smart cities.
fullDescription: GITEX Global is one of the biggest technology gatherings in the Middle East, uniting enterprises, governments, investors and start-ups. The exhibition covers artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, cloud computing, fintech, smart city infrastructure and digital government. Alongside the show floor, visitors can attend conferences, pitch competitions and networking sessions that connect early-stage companies with corporate partners and venture capital.
altText: Crowd gathered around technology stands and screens at GITEX Global 2027 in Dubai

name: MEDICA 2027
shortDescription: A leading international medical trade fair for imaging, laboratory technology, health IT and clinical equipment.
fullDescription: MEDICA is a major international medical trade fair held in Düsseldorf, covering imaging and diagnostics, laboratory equipment, physiotherapy, orthopaedic technology, health IT and consumables. Hospital buyers, distributors and clinicians meet suppliers from around the world to evaluate new products and agree distribution partnerships. The accompanying forums and conferences focus on digital health, medical innovation and the transformation of healthcare delivery.
altText: Medical technology exhibitors and visitors in a hall at MEDICA 2027 in Düsseldorf
